name: Alex. Metzger
bio: Alex. Metzger of Bismarck visited Medora in April, August and September 1884. The paper gives no other details about him.
mentions: Mr. Alex. Metzger, of Bismarck, was in town Wednesday. His genial grip is ever welcome.
